title: Bundle size check fails on ESM output
body:
`scripts/check-bundle-size.js` globs `dist/assets/*.js` and sums the gzip size of every match. Since the Vite 5 upgrade the ESM build emits `dist/assets/*.mjs` alongside the legacy `.js` chunks, so the check sums a subset of the real payload and reports a number well under the budget.

Steps to reproduce:

1. `npm ci`
2. `npm run build`
3. `node scripts/check-bundle-size.js`

Expected: the reported total matches the sum of every emitted entry chunk.
Actual: the total omits every `.mjs` chunk, so the gate passes even when the bundle grows past the budget.

The fix is probably one glob and a test, but the budget constant should be re-derived from a real build rather than kept at its current value by accident.
